assert sf('""') == ['']

assert sf('"a",b,c') == ['a','b','c']
assert sf('ab"c,d') == ['ab"c','d']
assert sf(' "a",b') == [' "a"','b']
assert sf('a,"b" c', sep="")  # not used
# empty field after leading sep
assert sf(',a') == ['','a']
assert sf('"a" , b') == ['a', ' b']
# sep inside quotes with space
assert sf('"x,y z",9', sep=",") == ['x,y z','9']
# semicolon sep
assert sf('"a;b",c', sep=";") == ['a;b','c']

    print("ok unterminated")
# text after close quote
try:
    sf('"a"x,y')
except ValueError:
    print("ok text after close")
else:
    print("FAIL after close")
# quote after space in first field literal
assert sf(' "a" ,b') == [' "a" ','b']
print("all good")
